panels.scene: Walt at his kitchen table, phone at his ear, smiling, the small green stovetop kettle on the stove behind them. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: Save me a slice of pie.

panels.scene: Dana in her own kitchen far away, a pie on the counter, phone at her ear, laughing. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: I'll send you the recipe instead.

panels.scene: Walt at his kitchen table moving a chess piece on a chess set, content, mug beside him, the small green stovetop kettle on the stove behind them. Top third plain wall.
panels.caption: Apart for the holiday. Still close.
